prompt: Add one more quiz question about partition pruning to an existing DataEngLab course (isolated copy of apache-spark-for-beginners), as an update rather than a fresh generation.

assertions.name: original-untouched
assertions.text: the original output/apache-spark-for-beginners/ directory was not modified

assertions.name: new-question-well-formed
assertions.text: the new quiz question follows the repo's field format with unique option letters and a correct answer matching an option

assertions.name: related-lesson-real
assertions.text: the new question's Related lesson references a lesson ID that actually exists in the copied course

assertions.name: topically-correct
assertions.text: the question and explanation are substantively about partition pruning

assertions.name: validation-actually-run
assertions.text: a real validation command was run against the change and its real result is quoted
